action: reduce successive plan sections toward one end or top
divergence: Measured on a bare extruded body, uncut by the envelope: massv2 taper removes 672 m3 (subtract) acting on 1 volume(s) (single). The BOOK records this word as subtract on single volumes. The two agree on both counts, so the second implementation is a restatement rather than a different word - it may still differ in proportion, which this bench does not measure.

mathematical_basis.reference: Barr, A.H. (1984) 'Global and Local Deformations of Solid Primitives', SIGGRAPH Computer Graphics 18(3), 21-30
mathematical_basis.definition: Scaling in the two axes normal to a chosen axis by a function of position along it: (x, y, z) -> (f(z)x, f(z)y, z). Volume falls with the integral of f squared, so a taper always subtracts.
mathematical_basis.shipped_as: 3ds Max Taper modifier / Maya nonlinear taper

delivery_contract.why: A unary AST chain, a decompose() != 1 refusal inside every macro, and a maximum_components=1 promotion gate. The reason is written in candidate_analysis.py: a detached piece is no more architectural than a small Lego speck, and split wings or arrays must be joined by an explicit bridge or spine.
delivery_contract.note: So the BOOK record's `multiple` means how many volumes the operative involves, NOT how many bodies come back.
